;;;; Score model.

(uiop:define-package #:demo/src/models/score
  (:use #:cl)
  (:export #:add-score))
(in-package #:demo/src/models/score)

(serapeum:-> add-score (integer integer)
    (values integer &optional))

files.src/numbers.lisp:
(uiop:define-package #:demo/src/numbers
  (:use #:cl)
  (:export #:sum-even))
(in-package #:demo/src/numbers)

(serapeum:-> sum-even (list)
    (values integer &optional))
(defun sum-even (numbers)
  "Return the sum of the even integers in NUMBERS, or zero for an empty list."
  (loop for number in numbers
        when (evenp number)
          sum number))

files.src/status.lisp:
;;;; HTTP status codes for demo.

(uiop:define-package #:demo/src/status
  (:use #:cl)
  (:export #:status-code))
(in-package #:demo/src/status)

(serapeum:-> status-code (t)
    (values (member 200 201 404) &optional))
(defun status-code (kind)
  "Return the HTTP status code for KIND, one of :NEW, :OK, or :MISSING.
Signal an error for any other value."
  (ecase kind
    (:new 201)
    (:ok 200)
    (:missing 404)))

files.src/validation.lisp:
;;;; Validation of numeric inputs.

(uiop:define-package #:demo/src/validation
  (:use #:cl)
  (:import-from #:serapeum
                #:->)
  (:export #:ensure-positive))
(in-package #:demo/src/validation)

(-> ensure-positive (real)
    (values real &optional))
(defun ensure-positive (value)
  "Return VALUE when it is positive; otherwise signal an error that reports VALUE."
  (if (plusp value)
      value
      (error "Expected a positive real number, got ~S" value)))

;;;; Value helper for the demo system.

(uiop:define-package #:demo/src/values
  (:use #:cl)
  (:export #:first-value))
(in-package #:demo/src/values)

(serapeum:-> first-value (t t)
    (values t &optional))
(defun first-value (value metadata)
  "Return VALUE unchanged, ignoring METADATA."
  (declare (ignore metadata))
  value)

files.src/hooks.lisp:
;;;; Hooks run after an object is saved.

(uiop:define-package #:demo/src/hooks
  (:use #:cl)
  (:export #:*after-save-hooks*
           #:run-after-save-hooks))
(in-package #:demo/src/hooks)

(defvar *after-save-hooks* nil
  "Functions called with the saved object in list order. Non-function elements are ignored.")

(serapeum:-> run-after-save-hooks (t)
    (values null &optional))
(defun run-after-save-hooks (object)
  "Call each function in *AFTER-SAVE-HOOKS* with OBJECT in list order.
Ignore non-function elements in the list. Return NIL."
  (dolist (hook *after-save-hooks*)
    (when (functionp hook)
      (funcall hook object))))
